entry.label: Forza Motorsport (2023)

support.summary: Built from community documentation and tested with generated data; not yet checked with the real game on this platform.
support.note: Implemented from Turn 10's Data Out doc (Sled 232 / Dash 311 / FM2023 331 B): tyre wear and track ordinal. Lap distance from DistanceTraveled. Synthetic tests only - not yet tested on a real console.

transport.summary: The game sends Data Out telemetry to this Mac's IP, port 5301 (Settings › Gameplay & HUD › UDP Race Telemetry).

features.label: Lap times
features.reason: Forza Motorsport sends lap times, but Pitwall works out where each lap ends, so a lap can stay untimed.
features.detail: lap_number: Dash.LapNumber (laps completed) + 1; current_lap_time_ms: Dash.CurrentLap (s -> ms); last_lap_time_ms: Dash.LastLap (s -> ms; 0 -> None); lap_completion: derived: LapNumber increment, time = Dash.LastLap (held up to 0.1 s for a stale LastLap, else untimed); valid=False only for a lap with a reset to track (trace un-anchored) (row forza_motorsport)

features.label: Sector times
features.reason: Forza Motorsport doesn't send sector times.
features.detail: no sector data (row forza_motorsport)

features.label: Live delta
features.reason: Forza sends no lap distance: Pitwall measures the distance you drive from the start line.
features.detail: lap_distance_m: derived: Dash.DistanceTraveled minus its value at the observed line crossing (driven line, not a centreline); None until the first crossing of a session and after a reset to track; current_lap_time_ms: Dash.CurrentLap (s -> ms) (row forza_motorsport)

features.label: Braking cues
features.reason: Forza sends no lap distance: Pitwall measures the distance you drive from the start line.
features.detail: brake: Dash.Brake (u8 0..255 -> 0..1); speed_kph: Dash.Speed (m/s -> km/h); Sled format: derived |Velocity| (m/s -> km/h); lap_distance_m: derived: Dash.DistanceTraveled minus its value at the observed line crossing (driven line, not a centreline); None until the first crossing of a session and after a reset to track (row forza_motorsport)

features.label: Corner coaching
features.reason: Forza sends no lap distance: Pitwall measures the distance you drive from the start line.
features.detail: brake: Dash.Brake (u8 0..255 -> 0..1); throttle: Dash.Accel (u8 0..255 -> 0..1); speed_kph: Dash.Speed (m/s -> km/h); Sled format: derived |Velocity| (m/s -> km/h); lap_distance_m: derived: Dash.DistanceTraveled minus its value at the observed line crossing (driven line, not a centreline); None until the first crossing of a session and after a reset to track (row forza_motorsport)

features.label: Track map
features.reason: Forza sends no lap distance: Pitwall measures the distance you drive from the start line.
features.detail: pos_x_m: Dash.PositionX (world m); pos_z_m: Dash.PositionZ (world m); lap_distance_m: derived: Dash.DistanceTraveled minus its value at the observed line crossing (driven line, not a centreline); None until the first crossing of a session and after a reset to track (row forza_motorsport)

features.label: Official corner names
features.reason: Pitwall's official corner names cover F1 25 only; Forza Motorsport corners are numbered from your laps.
features.detail: no hand-checked track sheet for this game (analysis.track_identity.load_sheets) (row forza_motorsport)

features.label: AI field braking model
features.reason: Forza Motorsport doesn't send the other cars' positions, so there is no AI field braking model.
features.detail: Data Out describes the player's car only (row forza_motorsport)

features.label: Flags & marshal zones

features.label: Fuel
features.reason: Forza sends only how full the tank is, not its size, so Pitwall doesn't show fuel yet.
features.detail: fuel_kg: Dash.Fuel is a 0..1 tank fraction without capacity (fraction in SessionInfo.extra['fuel_fraction']) (row forza_motorsport)

features.detail: tyre_surface_temp_c: Dash.TireTemp* (one value per tyre; degF per community docs -> degC; surface vs core undocumented) (row forza_motorsport)

features.reason: Forza Motorsport sends tyre wear.
features.detail: tyre_wear_pct: FM2023 only: TireWear* (0..1 wear fraction per community -> %) (row forza_motorsport)

notes: Implemented from Turn 10's official field list + community packet sizes; synthetic-validated only.
Select the 'Dash' packet format in game: 'Sled' (232 B) has no position, lap, input or tyre data.
Lap distance is the driven distance (DistanceTraveled), not a centreline: a 1 % longer line moves the end of a 4 km lap ~40 m. The first lap of a session (no observed line crossing) is not assembled.
A lap whose time (LastLap) lags the lap counter by more than 0.1 s is stored untimed (unverified game behaviour: the hold is kept short so live cues are not delayed).
No sector times, lap validity, pit state, weather or setup in the protocol.
Gear 0 / reverse / neutral encoding undocumented: reported as None until verified with a capture.
